Container.Name: Digital Legacy
Container.Overview: Beta: self-hosted check-in and dry-run console for a digital legacy plan. Beneficiary release is not yet implemented.
Container.Description: Digital Legacy currently provides owner sign-in with TOTP, check-in scheduling and an isolated dry run. The real release flow and beneficiary portal are not implemented; no automatic release takes place. SQLite data and application keys persist in /data. Configure a local storage path, HTTPS reverse proxy and bootstrap token before first use.
Container.Requires: Beta software; use local storage for SQLite and an HTTPS reverse proxy. The beneficiary release flow is not implemented.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Porta HTTP interna per il reverse proxy; non esporre direttamente su Internet.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Storage locale persistente per database, chiavi, log e backup; UID 1654.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Dominio pubblico effettivo, senza schema o porta.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IP
Config.Description: Indirizzo IP del container Nginx Proxy Manager visto da Digital Legacy.

Config.Name: Bootstrap token
Config.Description: Token casuale di almeno 32 byte; rimuoverlo dopo aver creato l'amministratore.

Config.Name: Key certificate password
Config.Description: Password del PFX; Unraid la conserva nel template sulla flash.
